name: skipvideo
description: Extensao de navegador que detecta e clica automaticamente em botoes de pular abertura/resumo/anuncio em plataformas de streaming.
author: Glauco Santos

scripts.build:pkg: rm -rf dist/skipvideo && mkdir -p dist/skipvideo && cp -r manifest.json src icons LICENSE dist/skipvideo/
scripts.package: npm run build:pkg && cd dist/skipvideo && zip -r -FS ../skipvideo.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd ../..
